headline: Margin disappoints; guidance lowered

highlights: Per (%) -18/-41/-54 12M Avg Val (INR M) 1197 Financial Snapshot (INR b) Y/E March FY26 FY27E FY28E Sales 44.0 52.4 66.0 Sales Gr. % 23.6 19.1 26.1 EBITDA 8.9 9.2 12.6 EBITDA margin % 20.3 17.6 19.1 Adj.
EBITDA margin stood at 15% vs. our estimate of 17%, impacted by commodity/raw material inflation and supply chain cost headwinds.

Margin pressure and lower other income weigh on earnings Financial Highlights  Consolidated revenue stood at INR13.5b (+21% YoY, +66% QoQ), 7% above our estimate.  EBITDA came in at INR2.1b (-10% YoY, +35% QoQ), 5% below our estimate.

EBITDA margin contracted 400bp QoQ to 15%.  APAT stood at INR0.5b (-45% YoY, +14% QoQ), 46% below our estimate, largely attributable to lower-than-expected other income, as WindWorld’s income was not consolidated in 2QFY27, unlike in 1QFY27.
valuation: The business generated ~INR5.8b revenue in FY26, with Inox Green holding a 75% stake.  The 4X turbine prototype installation is complete, with commissioning expected shortly and commercial launch targeted by end-FY27.
Valuation and view  Based on a valuation multiple of 20x FY28E EPS, we arrive at a TP of INR74 per share.

FY28 guidance  Management has provided an initial FY28 revenue target of ~INR75b.  The company will review and reaffirm the FY28 outlook at the end of 4QFY27.  Long-term EBITDA margin objective remains at ~20%, supported by greater equipment-supply contribution, operating leverage, and higher manufacturing value addition.
watch: EBITDA margin stood at 15% vs. our estimate of 17%, impacted by commodity/raw material inflation and supply chain cost headwinds.

Turnkey orders currently account for ~39%.  The strategy involves consciously giving up certain turnkey orders/revenue opportunities to reduce working-capital intensity, improve collections, and strengthen the balance sheet.
